name: sonicwall-mcp
description: Cyber-insurance posture for a whole SonicWall fleet: firmware, advisories, MFA, SSL-VPN exposure and licences, one row per firewall.

sonicwall_msw_api_key.title: MySonicWall API key
sonicwall_msw_api_key.description: Your MySonicWall API key, sent as X-API-KEY. nsm-login (CLI or the nsm_login tool) mints the NSM session token from it, and licence and blind-spots checks read MySonicWall with it. Use an account whose NSM role is read-only.

sonicwall_nsm_token.title: NSM session token (leave blank)
sonicwall_nsm_token.description: Optional override; leave blank. Run `sonicwall-cli nsm-login` (or the nsm_login tool) instead, which saves the token. A pasted token expires after 8 hours (15 minutes idle) and keeps overriding the saved one.

sonicwall_region.title: NSM region
sonicwall_region.description: NSM SaaS region in https://nsm-{region}.sonicwall.com: uswest (default) or eucentral for EU portals.

sonicwall_base_url.title: Base URL override (testing)
sonicwall_base_url.description: Optional; leave blank. Sends every NSM and MySonicWall call to this base URL instead, for tests and mock servers.

sonicwall_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP mode
sonicwall_mcp_read_only.description: Optional. Set to 1 to hide tools that change NSM, MySonicWall or firewall state and refuse non-GET execute calls. Tools still write local state: the response cache, posture snapshots and learning entries. Preset to 1; clear it only when you want the agent to make changes.

sonicwall_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
sonicwall_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment); callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Leave blank for Claude Desktop.

sonicwall_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
sonicwall_user_agent.description: Optional. Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends to NSM and MySonicWall. Leave blank to use the built-in one.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile (optional)
printing_press_client_profile.description: Only used when the MCP server is bound to a tenant-gated client profile. This connector registers no tenant-gated source, so leave it blank.
